clock.limitation: Host receipt lower envelope is not independently measured board-to-host synchronization.

release_windows.name: accidental_first_drop
release_windows.context: User reports accidentally knocking upright down; excluded from intended-release aggregate.

release_windows.name: intentional_negative_release
release_windows.context: User-reported release from negative20–30degrees; trajectory supports outward fall then damped oscillation. Exact hand-off instant unavailable.

release_windows.name: intentional_positive_release
release_windows.context: User-reported release from positive20–30degrees; trajectory supports outward fall then damped oscillation. Exact hand-off instant unavailable.

method.model: Fixed order4 coefficients trained on rotation03 first moving direction. No refit, new harmonics, re-anchoring or lag selection on06.
method.timing: Primary proxy−17ms unchanged. Sensitivity−42..+8ms is descriptive, not fitted latency. Host receipt/source readback times do not establish exposure latency. Fast residuals therefore cannot be assigned entirely to a static angular error.
method.window_selection: User report separates accidental first drop from later negative and positive releases. Each scored window starts80ms after first sustained50ms outward |firmware omega|>=2rad/s in its trajectory interval. This is a conservative trajectory-defined window, not direct contact-state evidence. Assisted raising and near-release held poses are excluded from intended aggregate.
method.observability: No images/event markers were supplied with this metadata archive. Hands-free attribution follows user report and trajectory; exact hand-off/contact forces remain unobserved.
method.camera: Raw marker-vector image angle. Reject invalid/stale/low-confidence/implausible-length frames using the unchanged base loader. Never interpolate camera tracks across gaps; encoder interpolation rejects>30ms telemetry gaps.
method.support: Fast damped oscillations emphasize lower half angles. Low-speed support is much narrower than full rotation03. Do not infer a full-angle validation from aggregate RMS.
method.native_info: INFO counts and native saved reference were preserved. encoder_raw_age_us measures time since value change, not acquisition age.

outcome: Frozen candidate remains unsuitable for deployment: it fails initial independent upright by about4.3degrees and improves some dynamic/hanging discrepancies without eliminating them. Fast falling residuals are strongly timing-sensitive; these windows cannot establish the required static correction or its physical cause.
